caption: 49,036 ratings is a big enough sample that a bad-fit organizer would show up in the score — this one's still sitting at 4.7 stars. Here's exactly how I laid the 25 pieces out across my Hemnes's narrow top drawer and wide bottom drawer. Full review linked in bio. Contains affiliate links.
